name: Gertiz Compatibility Patches
description:
Compatibility patches for Gertiz.

Supported mods:
• asylum-town
• cradle-town
• death-valley-town
• hota.cove
• nevermore-town
• new-monsters-pack.axolotl-creatures-pack
• new-monsters-pack.doomMod
• new-monsters-pack.extra-creature-pack
• third-upgrades (tumSpecter)
• wake-of-gods.creatures

You can safely enable any number of sub-patches at the same time.
